questions.question: What is total store sales revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is total store sales quantity?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantity FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is total store sales profit?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is the store sales profit margin?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) / SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_profit_margin FROM tpcds.store_sales

questions.question: What is total catalog sales revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(cs_net_paid) AS catalog_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.catalog_sales

questions.question: What is total catalog sales quantity?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantity FROM tpcds.catalog_sales

questions.question: What is total catalog sales profit?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit FROM tpcds.catalog_sales

questions.question: What is the catalog sales profit margin?

questions.question: What is total web sales quantity?

questions.question: What is total web sales profit?

questions.question: What is the web sales profit margin?

questions.question: How many units were returned to stores?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantity FROM tpcds.store_returns

questions.question: What is the total store return amount?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(sr_return_amt) AS store_returns_amount FROM tpcds.store_returns

questions.question: What is the total catalog return amount?

questions.question: What is the total web return amount?

questions.question: Show store sales revenue by state.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT s_state, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.store_sales JOIN tpcds.store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_state ORDER BY s_state

questions.question: Show web sales revenue by customer state.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ca_state, SUM(ws_net_paid) AS web_sales_revenue FROM tpcds.web_sales JOIN tpcds.customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_state ORDER BY ca_state
